description: This file defines patterns for categorizing and including/excluding unit test files in a project, including specific pattern arrays for different test sets and functions to identify whether a given file matches these categories.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file is a unit config test file based on inclusion and exclusion patterns.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file is part of the bundled plugin dependent unit test files.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file is a boundary test file based on predefined patterns.
